summary: Portugal’s country-specific ecosystem commitment is a mixed conservation-and-restoration LULUCF target of -968 Kt CO2eq by 2030, rather than a hectare- or percentage-based national land target. Within the 2022 land-cover context, forests cover 41,298 km² (44.8%) and agriculture 44,277 km² (48.1%), while grasslands account for only 0.8%. The NDC also reports EU-level measures: a 310 Mt CO2 net-removals target for 2030; restoration measures in at least 20% of EU land areas and 20% of sea areas by 2030; and Common Agricultural Policy allocations in which 40% of the EU financial allocation supports climate objectives in 2023–2027, at least 25% of annual direct-payment funds is earmarked for eco-schemes, and 35% of Pillar II funds is dedicated to environment-and-climate activities. These are collective EU commitments, not Portugal-specific area or farming-coverage targets.
